# v0.1.27 preview

The engine version is 0.1.27. The capability version remains 12.

Job steps default `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS`, `NUM_JOBS`, and `RAYON_NUM_THREADS` to
the job's two-CPU quota and set `MAKEFLAGS=-j2`. Workflow, job, and step
environment values can override these defaults. Cargo gives
`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS` precedence over `build.jobs` in `.cargo/config.toml`.
Set the variable in the workflow or pass `--jobs N` to Cargo to choose
another count.

Each service container now has a one-CPU quota, down from two. Database
services and other CPU-intensive services may take longer under load.

When a pull request's merge ref differs from the listed base or head, the
poller rechecks it up to three times in the same pass. If the base or head
moves, the next pass evaluates the new commits. Each recheck logs a
`trust_recheck` entry on stderr.
